select dict.TABLE_ID tableId, bt.TABLE_NAME tableName, dict.DICT_ID dictId, dict.DICT_CODE dictCode, dict.DICT_NAME dictName, sd.ITEM_VALUE dictType, sdl.ITEM_VALUE dictTypeDesc, dict.DICT_SOURCE dictSource, dict.UPDATE_TIME updateTime from BOK_TABLEDICT dict left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sd on dict.DICT_TYPE = sd.ITEM_CODE and sd.DICT_CODE = 'DICT_TYPE'
left join BOK_TABLELIST bt on bt.STATUS = 'E' and dict.TABLE_ID = bt.TABLE_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl on sdl.DICT_CODE = 'DATA_TYPE' and sdl.STATUS = 'E' and sdl.ITEM_CODE = dict.DICT_TYPE where dict.STATUS = 'E' and dict.TABLE_ID = #{tableId}

select UPDATE_TIME from BOK_TABLEDICT where STATUS = 'E' and DICT_ID = #{dictId}
